## Delivery checks

- [ ] Active TASK and implementation plan contain matching requirement metadata.
- [ ] No task enters implementation through a `предложено`, `отклонено`, or
      `pending` requirement.
- [ ] Behavior changes update requirement text/history and CHANGELOG in this task.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_requirements.py` passes.
